# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Load phenotypes
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.4.Subanalysis_3/15.4.Subanalysis_transformed_cont_age")
phenotypes <- read.delim("phenotypes_filtered.txt")
  
# Load GWAS results
SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM_cont <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC/15.4.Subanalysis_3/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_DP_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|> 
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))

```

```{r}
cont_shap <- shapiro.test(phenotypes$continuous_sqrt)$p.value

## Rank-based inverse normal transformation
p_hist <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(x=continuous)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Histogram: Untransformed Continuous Age of onset (in days)")

p_qq <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(sample=continuous)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(col="red") +
  ggtitle("QQ-plot: Untransformed Continuous Age of onset (in days)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate(
    "text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("Shapiro-Wilk p = ", signif(cont_shap,2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size=4, color="blue"
  )

(p_hist + p_qq)


# Transform 
## rank-based inverse normal transformation
rank_inverse_normal <- function(x) {
  # Get ranks, preserving NAs
  r <- rank(x, ties.method = "average", na.last = "keep")
  n <- sum(!is.na(x))
  # Scale ranks to open interval (0,1)
  p <- (r - 0.5) / n
  # Transform
  qnorm(p)
}
phenotypes$continuous_RIN <- rank_inverse_normal(phenotypes$continuous)

## Log transformation
phenotypes$continuous_log1p <- log1p(phenotypes$continuous)

## SQRT transformation
phenotypes$continuous_sqrt <- sqrt(phenotypes$continuous)

# # Box-Cox Transformation
# library(bestNormalize)
# phenotypes$continuous_yeojohnson <- yeojohnson(phenotypes$continuous)$x.t

# Calculate Shapiro-Wilk test p-values
rin_shap <- shapiro.test(phenotypes$continuous_RIN)$p.value
log1p_shap <- shapiro.test(phenotypes$continuous_log1p)$p.value
sqrt_shap <- shapiro.test(phenotypes$continuous_sqrt)$p.value

## Rank-based inverse normal transformation
p_hist_rin <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(x=continuous_RIN)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Histogram: Rank-based Inverse Normal")

p_qq_rin <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(sample=continuous_RIN)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(col="red") +
  ggtitle("QQ-plot: Rank-based Inverse Normal") +
  theme_minimal() +
  annotate(
    "text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("Shapiro-Wilk p = ", signif(rin_shap,2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size=4, color="blue"
  )

(p_hist_rin + p_qq_rin)

## Log1p transformation
p_hist_log1p <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(x=continuous_log1p)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Histogram: Log1p")

p_qq_log1p <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(sample=continuous_log1p)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(col="red") +
  ggtitle("QQ-plot: Log1p") +

    "text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("Shapiro-Wilk p = ", signif(log1p_shap,2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size=4, color="blue"
  )

(p_hist_log1p + p_qq_log1p)


## SQRT transformation
p_hist_sqrt <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(x=continuous_sqrt)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=30) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("Histogram: SQRT")

p_qq_sqrt <- ggplot(phenotypes, aes(sample=continuous_sqrt)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(col="red") +

  theme_minimal() +
  annotate(
    "text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
    label = paste0("Shapiro-Wilk p = ", signif(sqrt_shap,2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size=4, color="blue"
  )

# Arrange plots: 
(p_hist_sqrt + p_qq_sqrt)
```
